Typed ranges and locks, seeded three-candidate family, inspect and compare pins
Use exact candidate without rebaking, preserve target and physical tile size in export
Personal recipe preview reuse, search and favorites, shared projects and snapshot restore

limits: Browser interactions and rendering of synthetic maps passed. Cookbook browsing used real recipe files and, separately, the pinned 392-node native catalog, with no native jobs. state_regressions.scope: Stale job, family, collection and project continuations; serialized history/restore and same-project control refresh across export setting changes.
